_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'We updated our organizational structure for the fiscal year ended November 3, 2019 (“fiscal year 2019”), resulting in three reportable segments: semiconductor solutions, infrastructure software and IP licensing', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2019 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2019 10-K says 'the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, which may adversely affect the timing and volume of sales of our products for use in traditional enterprise data centers'. At the same time it sells into data centers itself: 'We offer a broad set of Ethernet switching and routing products that are optimized for data center, service provider network, enterprise network'. The stock trades at 29.8x FY20E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'We updated our organizational structure for the fiscal year ended November 3, 2019 (“fiscal year 2019”), resulting in three reportable segments: semiconductor solutions, infrastructure software and IP licensing', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2019 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.63x; +57% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.14; conservative 2yr -29%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 ex-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -2.4%/yr (Q2 FY20 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY14 ex-FY16 ex-FY18 median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.1%/yr (FY10-FY19 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 ex-FY18 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +50.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 ex-FY18, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2020-03-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.63x (58.9% downside to Bear $78.95 / +93.7% upside to Bull $372.36) | Adj composite 2.21 vs market 2.35: gap -0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +57% above the EPP floor $122.74 (19x FY20E $6.46) | Conservative 2-yr case: -28.9% total (-14.5%/yr) | At 29.8x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $254.21 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net revenue +1.2% YoY in Q1 FY20, forward revenues +0.6-6% (Q2 FY20 revenue guide (Q1 FY20 release)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
